title: Estate catalogue — fallback renderer
description_html:
Every asset the estate owns, generated from ~/.estate/state/inventory.json by idp/bin/db-gen. This is the fallback renderer. The primary is Backstage on port 8443. They share no runtime, so a broken Node install cannot take this page down.

Every number here is a SQL query you can edit and re-run. Nothing is asserted.

assets.description: One row per asset: repositories, scheduled jobs, guards, ledgers, data stores and drills.

meta.description: When the inventory this database was built from was taken.

risk_summary.sql: select 'repos with no licence file' as risk, count(*) as n from assets where kind='repo' and licence_file='ABSENT' union all select 'drills never run', count(*) from assets where kind='drill' and (last_status is null or last_status='NEVER RUN') union all select 'repos with uncommitted work', count(*) from assets where kind='repo' and dirty > 0 union all select 'repos not backed up offsite', count(*) from assets where kind='repo' and offsite is not 1 union all select 'assets coupled to one provider', count(*) from assets where coupling is not null and coupling != 'none'
risk_summary.title: What a buyer asks first
risk_summary.description: The five counts diligence starts with. Edit the SQL to check any of them yourself.
